name: smwgraphics-tb-the-blue-guy
title: TB the Blue Guy
description:
Who is TB? TB is true blue, terrifically bold in the face of danger, and might just be the best. Requested by, and Minecraft skin (and original character?) of, MarioIsTheBest1234. There are some extra palettes to help TB work in your own context.

Contents
Graphics files:
GFX00 (required)
GFX10 (overworld sprite)
GFX22 and GFX24 (only needed vs vanilla Bowser)
GFX28 (status bar)
GFX32 (required)

Asar patches:
fixes.asm (contains a few necessary hex edits)

6 player palettes (shared SMWPAL for the player, and custom PAL with PALMASKs for the overworld)

Readme will guide you on specific changes, important links, and a description of each palette.
